scope: Provisional root actual-path inspection before adapter-ready/freeze, not terminal author audit. Recheck findings on frozen bytes.

findings.observation: proc.communicate(timeout=child_seconds) buffers complete stdout/stderr in memory before truncation. It is not bounded stream capture; a noisy native process can exceed memory before the deadline.
findings.required: Stream each pipe with bounded retained buffers and incremental count/hash, stop/reap child group on overflow/deadline within monotonic bound; retain overflow failure and raw exit, never113assertion on truncated output. Tests must exercise actual callable capture with harmless controlled Python child, not only injected prebounded result.

findings.observation: Any SIGSEGV token plus last killed-by line is attributed to interpreterExit without binding PID to interpreter exec. A parser or macro process SIGSEGV after another process execs interpreter is misattributed.
findings.required: Bind signal to observed interpreter PID/exec and explicit PID trace lines or leave interpreterExit unknown; raw independent result review still required. Add separate parser-signal/interpreter-normal/ambiguousPID controls.
